_readme: One engine, many faces. Same tools, same wiring — only the palette, the type and the words change. Pick one with ?theme=<id>, or set shop.theme on a tenant so their people always land in the right skin. Add another by adding a block here; no code change.
_video: Any face can have a real presenter instead of the drawn one. Add "video": "https://…/her.mp4" and the intro plays that in place of the face — filmed, or generated with Hedra or the like. Add "poster" for the still it shows before it plays. She still types the same lines underneath, so the page works with the sound off and reads the same if the video never loads.

skrewu.name: SKREW U
skrewu.for: Our own people. Underground, print shop floor, no polish.
skrewu.bodyBg: radial-gradient(900px 520px at 50% -12%, rgba(196,241,53,.09), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(700px 420px at 12% 108%, rgba(196,42,31,.10), transparent 58%), #0a0908
intro: Alright — this'll take twenty seconds.
Everything you make runs down one line. Art in one end, a boxed order out the other.
It's all open. Every tool, right now. Nothing locked, nothing to unlock.
You choose the way through — gang sheets, shirts, stickers, or just the orders.
Any of them. They all come out the same end.
And it's never stuck. Add a part, move one, throw one out. The line is yours.
skrewu.ask: So — which one sounds like you?
